problem_markdown: Let $A$ be the decimal digit sum of $4444^{4444}$, and let $B$ be the digit sum of $A$. Determine the digit sum of $B$.
solutions_markdown: The power is below $10^{17776}$, so $A\le9\cdot17776=159984$ and consequently $B\le54$. Digit sums preserve residues modulo nine. Since $4444\equiv-2\pmod9$ and $(-2)^3\equiv1\pmod9$, we obtain $B\equiv(-2)^{4444}\equiv7\pmod9$. Thus $B$ is one of $7,16,25,34,43,52$, each with digit sum seven. The answer is $7$.
